findings.observation: The deepest skin, high arched brows, broad low bridge and full closed lips remain recognizable, but the output replaces the summon’s close-set small adult eyes and angular diamond cheek and jaw planes with enlarged round eyes and a softened rounded face that reads significantly younger and closer to a generic doll template than the mature 24-year-old source.

The chibi preserves Nelu’s tall-language conditioned athletic construction through a narrow upright torso, restrained shoulder width, low body mass, functional leg tone, and poised posture without ripped definition or generic bulk inflation.
Both slim upper arms and forearms remain source-relative, taper through readable wrists, and end in two naturally scaled empty hands without glove-like inflation or duplicate anatomy.

The brown-chestnut short textured crop preserves the source’s close side and crown silhouette and contains exactly one clearly bounded clipped pale color panel, with no added hair ornament or extra accent.

The moss-ivory long tunic and split tabard retain contrasting green inner edges, visible prideful hand repairs, shaped triangular cloth clasp, loose trousers, wrapped ankles, low boots, and one quiet map roll visibly stowed at the right waist while both hands remain empty. No tattoo or unrelated accessory is added.

Original-resolution inspection places the complete topmost-hair-to-chin unit at approximately 29–30 percent of standing height when compared with the same topmost hair point to the lower boot sole. This is below the frozen 32–36 percent band and reads near 3.4 heads tall.

Exactly one subject appears with the entire textured crop and clipped panel, complete head, both empty hands, stowed map roll, split tabard tips, both wrapped ankles, and both boots fully inside generous parchment margins.

The grounded three-quarter stance, separated planted feet, low empty guard, bold moss-ivory color blocks, split tabard, pale hair panel, and waist-stowed roll remain legible at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The repaired cloth layers, shaped clasp, wrapped ankles, boots, and map roll remain ordinary mortal details with no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
